creators.name: Wei Lan
creators.role: Researcher, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher at Keio KMD who designs multisensory haptic systems for traditional Chinese somatic practices such as tai chi.
creators.bio_zh: 庆应 KMD 的人机交互研究者，为太极等中国传统身体修习设计多感官触觉系统。
creators.why: Turns tai chi's qi into felt airflow and vibration at the palm, making an East Asian body-mind concept into design material.
creators.why_zh: 把太极的“气”转化为掌心可感的气流与振动，让东亚的身心观念成为设计材料。

creators.name: Shuai Zou
creators.role: Researcher, Computational Media and Arts, HKUST (Guangzhou)
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）计算媒体与艺术学域研究者
creators.bio: Researcher at the Creative Intelligence and Synergy Lab of HKUST (Guangzhou) who makes VR artworks that stage Chinese philosophy through multispecies perception.
creators.bio_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）创意智能与协同实验室研究者，以多物种感知的虚拟现实作品演绎中国哲学。
creators.why: Translates Zhuangzi's idea of transformation between beings into an embodied VR passage through other species' senses.
creators.why_zh: 把庄子“物化”的思想转译为一段穿行于其他物种感官之中的具身虚拟现实体验。

creators.name: Xinyi Huang
creators.role: Designer-researcher, Donghua University
creators.role_zh: 东华大学设计研究者
creators.bio: Fashion and wearable-technology researcher at Donghua University who builds shape-changing garments and haptic wearables.
creators.bio_zh: 东华大学的时尚与可穿戴技术研究者，制作形变服装与触觉可穿戴设备。
creators.why: Proposes a Taoist approach to embodied interaction, using flow, wu wei, qi and yin-yang to guide how actuated garments move with the body.
creators.why_zh: 提出具身交互的道家路径，以流动、无为、气与阴阳指导驱动式服装如何随身体而动。

creators.name: Mia Huong Nguyen
creators.role: PhD researcher, Augmented Human Lab, National University of Singapore
creators.role_zh: 新加坡国立大学增强人类实验室博士研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who studies gut-based interaction: sensing emotions from abdominal sounds and shaping gastric feelings with audio-haptic feedback.
creators.bio_zh: 研究以肠胃为界面的交互：从腹部声音感知情绪，并用声音触觉反馈塑造胃部感受。
creators.why: Opens the gut as an interoceptive site for design, showing that sound and vibration on the belly change felt hunger and behaviour.
creators.why_zh: 把肠胃开辟为可设计的内感受部位，证明腹部的声音与振动能改变饥饿感与行为。

creators.name: Suranga Nanayakkara
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Computing, National University of Singapore; director, Augmented Human Lab
creators.role_zh: 新加坡国立大学计算机学院副教授，增强人类实验室负责人
creators.bio: Computer scientist who leads the Augmented Human Lab at NUS (earlier at the University of Auckland), designing perceptual and assistive augmentations that people experience as part of their own body.
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，领导新加坡国立大学增强人类实验室（此前在奥克兰大学），设计让人感到属于自身身体的感知与辅助增强。
creators.why: The lab's embodiment-first approach to augmentation now reaches inside the body, as in its gut-feeling projects GutIO and VisceroHaptics.
creators.why_zh: 该实验室以具身为先做人类增强，如今延伸到身体内部，例如关于“肠胃感觉”的 GutIO 与 VisceroHaptics。

creators.name: Mai Kamihori
creators.role: Researcher, Computer-Human Interaction Lab (χLab), Aoyama Gakuin University
creators.role_zh: 青山学院大学人机交互实验室（χLab）研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher at Aoyama Gakuin University who models and modulates the inner sensations of eating and drinking.
creators.bio_zh: 青山学院大学的人机交互研究者，对饮食时的内在感觉进行建模与调节。
creators.why: Treats the throat as a place where internal bodily feelings can be both sensed and redesigned.
creators.why_zh: 把喉咙当作既能感知又能重新设计内在身体感受的部位。

creators.name: Weijen Chen
creators.role: Researcher, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）研究者
creators.bio: Designer-researcher in human-food interaction at Keio KMD who combines biofeedback, food and multisensory dining.
creators.bio_zh: 庆应 KMD 的人与食物交互设计研究者，把生物反馈、食物与多感官用餐结合在一起。
creators.why: Makes the diner's own heartbeat visible in the food, turning eating into an act of bodily attention and shared rhythm.
creators.why_zh: 让食客自己的心跳在食物中显现，把进食变成一种身体觉察与共享节律的行为。

creators.name: Mirna Zordan
creators.role: Researcher, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
creators.role_zh: 南方科技大学研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher at SUSTech whose group builds biofeedback, neurofeedback and soma design systems for stress, breathing and sleep.
creators.bio_zh: 南方科技大学的设计研究者，团队为压力、呼吸与睡眠开发生物反馈、神经反馈与身体设计系统。
creators.why: The Shenzhen group frames physiological computing through soma design and interoception, from shared stress to falling asleep.
creators.why_zh: 这支深圳团队以身体设计与内感受来构思生理计算，从共同分担压力到入睡。

creators.name: Chan Qiu
creators.role: Researcher, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
creators.role_zh: 南方科技大学研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher at SUSTech working on multisensory biofeedback for interoceptive awareness and sleep.
creators.bio_zh: 南方科技大学的设计研究者，研究面向内感受觉察与睡眠的多感官生物反馈。
creators.why: Designs interaction that fades out so that the body's own rhythms can take over.
creators.why_zh: 设计会逐渐退场的交互，让身体自身的节律接管。

creators.name: Fan Zhang
creators.role: Researcher, School of Creative Media, City University of Hong Kong
creators.role_zh: 香港城市大学创意媒体学院研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher in Ray LC's Studio for Narrative Spaces who studies how dancers improvise through motion-capture avatars.
creators.bio_zh: Ray LC 的叙事空间工作室中的人机交互研究者，研究舞者如何借助动作捕捉化身即兴。
creators.why: Shows avatars as a way for dancers to estrange habitual movement and try out other bodies and genders.
creators.why_zh: 揭示化身可以帮助舞者把习惯动作陌生化，尝试另一种身体与性别。

creators.name: Ray LC
creators.role: Assistant Professor, School of Creative Media, City University of Hong Kong; Studio for Narrative Spaces
creators.role_zh: 香港城市大学创意媒体学院助理教授，叙事空间工作室负责人
creators.bio: Artist and researcher who leads the Studio for Narrative Spaces at CityU Hong Kong, studying performance with dancers, robots, avatars and haptics.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与研究者，在香港城市大学领导叙事空间工作室，研究舞者、机器人、化身与触觉参与的表演。
creators.why: The studio is an East Asian hub of dance-tech research that asks how technologies change the felt practice of moving bodies.
creators.why_zh: 该工作室是东亚舞蹈科技研究的重要据点，追问技术如何改变舞动身体的亲身实践。

creators.name: Shuto Takashita
creators.role: Researcher, Inami Lab, RCAST, The University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: 东京大学先端科学技术研究中心稻见实验室研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who designs proprioceptive and skin-stretch feedback for virtual body extensions and studies self-expression through avatars.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，为虚拟身体延伸设计本体感与皮肤拉伸反馈，并研究借助化身的自我表达。
creators.why: Gives extra body parts a felt joint, so that a virtual tail can be sensed and not only seen.
creators.why_zh: 为多出来的身体部位提供一个可感的关节，让虚拟尾巴不只被看见，也能被感觉到。

creators.name: Han Shi
creators.role: Researcher, Southern University of Science and Technology and Fudan University
creators.role_zh: 南方科技大学与复旦大学研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who uses haptic retargeting to create body illusions in virtual reality.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，利用触觉重定向在虚拟现实中制造身体错觉。
creators.why: Shows that guided self-touch can change the felt shape of one's own body.
creators.why_zh: 证明被引导的自我触摸可以改变自己身体被感到的形状。

creators.name: Seungwoo Je
creators.role: Leads the Immersive Design Group, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
creators.role_zh: 南方科技大学沉浸式设计组负责人
creators.bio: Korean HCI researcher in Shenzhen whose group works on haptic retargeting, body illusions in VR and breathing-based social systems.
creators.bio_zh: 在深圳工作的韩国人机交互研究者，团队研究触觉重定向、虚拟现实中的身体错觉与基于呼吸的社交系统。
creators.why: The group links haptics engineering with felt changes in body image and social presence.
creators.why_zh: 该团队把触觉工程与身体意象、社会临场感的亲身变化联系起来。

creators.name: Yingtong Lu
creators.role: Researcher, School of Computer Science and Engineering, Southeast University
creators.role_zh: 东南大学计算机科学与工程学院研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher in Zhuying Li's group who designs social body games and bodily play with shared and extra limbs.
creators.bio_zh: Zhuying Li 团队的人机交互研究者，设计社交身体游戏以及共享肢体、多余肢体的身体游戏。
creators.why: Explores bodily intertwinement, where two players co-inhabit one avatar body.
creators.why_zh: 探索“身体交织”：两名玩家共同栖居于同一个化身身体。

creators.name: Jiyun Bae
creators.role: Researcher, Sophia University
creators.role_zh: 上智大学研究者
creators.bio: Researcher at Sophia University in Tokyo who writes on dance improvisation, butoh and somaesthetics.
creators.bio_zh: 东京上智大学的研究者，撰写关于舞蹈即兴、舞踏与身体美学的文章。
creators.why: Documents butoh dancer Toru Iwashita's 'life-size' improvisation and dance therapy for the somaesthetics community.
creators.why_zh: 为身体美学领域记录舞踏舞者岩下徹“等身大”的即兴与舞蹈治疗。

creators.name: Xueting Luo
creators.role: Researcher, University of Leeds
creators.role_zh: 利兹大学研究者
creators.bio: Researcher at the University of Leeds who studies Chinese classical dance and martial arts through somaesthetics.
creators.bio_zh: 利兹大学的研究者，以身体美学研究中国古典舞与武术。
creators.why: Brings shenyun (body rhythm) and taiji and bajiquan training into somaesthetics as forms of self-cultivation.
creators.why_zh: 把身韵以及太极、八极拳的训练作为修身方式带入身体美学的讨论。

creators.name: Ran Zhou
creators.role: Researcher, University of Chicago and KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学与瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who designs expressive on-body haptics and touch toolkits, working between the University of Chicago's Actuated Experience Lab and Madeline Balaam's group at KTH.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，设计富有表现力的身体触觉与触摸工具包，往返于芝加哥大学 Actuated Experience Lab 与 KTH 的 Madeline Balaam 团队之间。
creators.why: Treats haptic design as crafting touch by hand, so designers can feel and compose touch on the body before engineering it.
creators.why_zh: 把触觉设计当作用手“手作”触摸，让设计者在工程实现之前先在身体上感受并编排触摸。

creators.name: Jiayi Shen
creators.role: Researcher, Embodied Media Project, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）Embodied Media 项目研究者
creators.bio: Media designer at Keio KMD who builds shared auditory-haptic spaces for several people at once.
creators.bio_zh: 庆应 KMD 的媒体设计者，为多人同时在场打造共享的听觉触觉空间。
creators.why: Creates a sense of being together through vibration felt in the body and sound shared in space, without relying on sight.
creators.why_zh: 不依赖视觉，而是通过身体感到的振动与空间中共享的声音营造“在一起”的感觉。

creators.name: Taiga Suzuki
creators.role: PhD student, The University of Tokyo (Inami-Monnai Laboratory) and AIST
creators.role_zh: 东京大学（稻见-门内实验室）博士生，产业技术综合研究所（AIST）
creators.bio: Human-augmentation researcher who studies how a machine can take part in the timing of a movement while the person still drives it.
creators.bio_zh: 人类增强研究者，研究机器如何参与动作的时机，而动作本身仍由人来驱动。
creators.why: Proposes augmenting skill by leaving the movement to the human body and letting the machine only decide when it is released.
creators.why_zh: 提出一种增强技能的方式：动作交给人的身体，机器只决定何时释放。

creators.name: Mamoru Watanabe
creators.role: Researcher, Bristol Interaction Lab, University of Bristol
creators.role_zh: 布里斯托大学交互实验室研究者
creators.bio: HCI researcher who co-designs tools with synaesthetes for depicting and sharing cross-sensory experience.
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，与联觉者共同设计用于描绘与分享跨感官体验的工具。
creators.why: Extends the body sheets of soma design into immersive 3D drawing, so that sensations without names can be articulated.
creators.why_zh: 把身体设计中的身体图纸扩展为沉浸式三维绘画，让难以命名的感觉得以表达。

creators.name: Yixun Li
creators.role: Researcher, Institute for Design Informatics, University of Edinburgh
creators.role_zh: 爱丁堡大学设计信息学研究所研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher who works with knitted soft robotics and feminist approaches to menstrual experience.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，以针织软体机器人和女性主义视角研究月经体验。
creators.why: Uses moving soft materials to express the felt, fluctuating qualities of menstrual pain instead of reducing it to numbers.
creators.why_zh: 用会动的柔软材料表达经痛被感受到的起伏质感，而不是把它简化为数字。

creators.name: Sachiyo Ito-Jaeger
creators.role: Researcher, Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences, University of Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 诺丁汉大学医学与健康科学学院研究者
creators.bio: Digital mental health researcher at the University of Nottingham who co-creates resources with young people and studies embodied approaches to well-being.
creators.bio_zh: 诺丁汉大学的数字心理健康研究者，与年轻人共同创作资源，并研究以身体为本的身心安适方法。
creators.why: Maps how soma design is being used in digital mental health, bringing the approach to a clinical and health audience.
creators.why_zh: 梳理身体设计在数字心理健康中的应用，把这一方法带给临床与健康领域的读者。

creators.name: Yeup Hur
creators.role: Researcher, Department of Industrial Design, Eindhoven University of Technology
creators.role_zh: 埃因霍温理工大学工业设计系研究者
creators.bio: Design researcher who develops frameworks for teaching somatic, movement-based interaction design.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，为身体与动作导向的交互设计教学构建框架。
creators.why: The ART framework turns first-person bodily exploration into a teachable design process for students.
creators.why_zh: 所提出的 ART 框架把第一人称的身体探索变成学生可以学习的设计流程。

creators.name: Ximing Shen
creators.role: Researcher, Embodied Media Project, Keio University Graduate School of Media Design (KMD)
creators.role_zh: 庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究科（KMD）Embodied Media 项目研究者
creators.bio: Researcher at Keio KMD who co-designs haptic performances with dancers and studies how audiences feel movement.
creators.bio_zh: 庆应 KMD 的研究者，与舞者共同设计触觉表演，研究观众如何感受动作。
creators.why: Extends dance from sight and sound to touch, so the audience's own body resonates with the dancer's.
creators.why_zh: 把舞蹈从视觉与听觉延伸到触觉，让观众自己的身体与舞者产生共振。

works.title: Qìfield
works.description: A VR tai chi system that gives qi a felt outline: airflow and vibration on the palm, modulated by forearm muscle activity and hand gestures, let practitioners feel intention and force extending outward beyond the hand.
works.description_zh: 一套虚拟现实太极系统，为“气”勾勒出可感的轮廓：掌心的气流与振动随前臂肌肉活动和手势变化，让练习者感到意念与力量从手中向外延伸。
works.idea_en: Qi, the joint regulation of intention, breath, movement and force, can be rendered as a sensation at the palm, turning an inner coordination into something a learner can feel and calibrate.
works.idea_zh: 气是意念、呼吸、动作与力量的协调；把它呈现为掌心的感觉，内在的协调就成了学习者可以感受、可以校准的东西。
works.method: Interviews with five professional tai chi practitioners framed the concept of 'volitional extension'; forearm EMG and hand tracking drive palm-centred airflow and vibrotactile actuators in a VR scene, tried by 12 participants.
works.method_zh: 通过访谈五位专业太极练习者提出“意志延伸”的概念；前臂肌电与手部追踪驱动以掌心为中心的气流与振动执行器，在虚拟场景中由 12 名参与者试用。

paper.title: Qìfield: Externalizing Qi as a Palmar Haptic Field for Volitional Extension in Tai Chi Practices

works.title: The Dream of Zhuang Zhou
works.description: A VR artwork based on Zhuangzi's Butterfly Dream: visitors pass through a classical Chinese landscape as a human, a fish, a butterfly and a bird, each with its own way of seeing and moving.
works.description_zh: 一件取材于庄子“庄周梦蝶”的虚拟现实作品：观众依次以人、鱼、蝴蝶与鸟的身份穿行于中国古典山水之中，每一种身体都有自己观看与移动的方式。
works.idea_en: Zhuangzi's 'transformation of things' can be staged as a sequence of bodily metamorphoses, so that the line between self and other species is felt rather than argued.
works.idea_zh: 庄子的“物化”可以被演绎为一连串身体的变形，让自我与其他物种之间的界线被亲身感到，而不只是被论证。
works.method: 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions rendered in a classical Chinese landscape style, with a separate perceptual and locomotion mapping for each of four species.
works.method_zh: 以三维高斯泼溅重建场景并呈现为中国古典山水风格，为四种物种分别设计感知与移动的映射。

paper.title: The Dream of Zhuang Zhou: Entangled Agencies in Multispecies Virtual Reality

works.title: Flow and Change
works.description: A design paper that reads three shape-changing wearables through Taoist principles: Flowing Out of the Body turns heart rate into garment movement, E-coral answers touch with pneumatic forms, and Skeleton-Wear uses haptics to heighten awareness of the body.
works.description_zh: 一篇以道家原则解读三件形变可穿戴设计的论文：Flowing Out of the Body 把心率变成服装的运动，E-coral 以气动形态回应触摸，Skeleton-Wear 用触觉增强对身体的觉察。
works.idea_en: Flow, wu wei, qi and yin-yang can serve as working principles for actuated materials, so a garment moves with the wearer's rhythms instead of directing them.
works.idea_zh: 流动、无为、气与阴阳可以成为驱动材料的设计原则，让服装随穿戴者的节律而动，而不是指挥穿戴者。
works.method: Research through design with three wearable prototypes using shape-changing textiles, pneumatics and haptic actuation, analysed against Taoist concepts.
works.method_zh: 以设计为研究：三件采用形变织物、气动与触觉驱动的可穿戴原型，并对照道家概念进行分析。

paper.title: Flow and change: a Taoist approach to embodied human-computer interaction and fashionable wearables design

works.title: VisceroHaptics
works.description: Sound and vibration patterns made from recorded stomach sounds are played onto the belly; wearers report hunger, fullness, thirst or an upset stomach, rate themselves hungrier and drink more water.
works.description_zh: 用录下的肠鸣声制成的声音与振动图案作用于腹部；佩戴者报告饥饿、饱胀、口渴或胃部不适，自评更饿，也喝下了更多水。
works.idea_en: Gut feelings can be addressed from the outside: rhythmic sound and vibration on the abdomen shift what the stomach seems to feel.
works.idea_zh: “肠胃的感觉”可以从外部去触及：腹部有节律的声音与振动会改变胃似乎感到的东西。
works.method: Patterns derived from clustered abdominal sounds drive audio-haptic actuators on the stomach; three experiments with 55 participants measured feelings, hunger ratings and water intake (Water Load Test-II).
works.method_zh: 由聚类后的腹部声音生成的图案驱动置于胃部的声音触觉执行器；三项共 55 人参与的实验测量了感受、饥饿评分与饮水量（水负荷测试 II）。

paper.title: VisceroHaptics: Investigating the Effects of Gut-based Audio-Haptic Feedback on Gastric Feelings and Gastric Interoceptive Behavior

works.title: Sensing and Modulating the Feel of a Drink
works.description: A neck-worn device warms or cools the skin over the larynx while a person drinks, changing how the drink feels going down; the effect depends on each person's interoceptive profile.
works.description_zh: 一款戴在颈部的装置，在人饮水时加热或冷却喉部皮肤，改变饮品咽下时的感觉；效果取决于每个人的内感受类型。
works.idea_en: The throat works in both directions: its skin temperature reveals how a swallow feels, and changing that temperature changes the feeling.
works.idea_zh: 喉咙是双向的：皮肤温度透露出吞咽的感觉，改变这一温度也就改变了感觉。
works.method: A first study (N=31) modelled ratings of drink sensation from laryngeal skin temperature and swallowed volume; a wearable thermal device then altered those sensations in a second study (N=20).
works.method_zh: 第一项研究（31 人）以喉部皮肤温度与吞咽量建模饮品感受评分；第二项研究（20 人）用可穿戴热反馈装置改变这些感受。

paper.title: Sensing and Modulating the Feel of a Drink: A Personalized Approach via Laryngeal Thermal Feedback

works.title: Living Bento
works.description: Translucent noodles glow with the diner's own heartbeat through LED tableware; in a shared version, diners eat food that pulses with each other's heart rate.
works.description_zh: 透明的面条借助 LED 餐具随食客自己的心跳发光；在共享版本中，食客吃下随对方心率跳动的食物。
works.idea_en: Putting the heartbeat into the food slows eating down and turns each bite into a moment of attending to one's own, or a companion's, living rhythm.
works.idea_zh: 把心跳放进食物里，进食就慢了下来，每一口都成为觉察自己或同伴生命节律的片刻。
works.method: Heart-rate sensors drive LEDs beneath transparent noodles in custom tableware; studies compared dining immersion, attentiveness and emotional bonds, including a 'Sharing Bio-Sync Food' condition.
works.method_zh: 心率传感器驱动定制餐具中透明面条下方的 LED；研究比较了用餐沉浸感、专注度与情感联结，包括“共享生物同步食物”条件。

paper.title: Living Bento: Heartbeat-Driven Noodles for Enriched Dining Dynamics

works.title: Please Share
works.description: In the system Minus × Minus = Plus, two people see their stress, read from EEG, as one shared visual field and transform it together through touch, so stress becomes something handled jointly.
works.description_zh: 在名为 Minus × Minus = Plus 的系统中，两个人把各自由脑电读出的压力看作同一片共享的视觉场，并通过触摸一起改变它，压力由此成为两人共同处理的东西。
works.idea_en: Stress is easier to share when it is externalised as a common material that two bodies can work on together.
works.idea_zh: 当压力被外化为两个身体可以共同处理的材料时，它就更容易被分享。
works.method: Real-time EEG from both participants drives a shared visualisation that the pair reshapes through two haptic interaction modes; tested with 55 pairs (110 participants).
works.method_zh: 两位参与者的实时脑电驱动一个共享的可视化，二人通过两种触觉交互方式改变它；共 55 对（110 人）参与测试。

paper.title: "Please Share": Promoting Embodied Forms of Interpersonal Stress Sharing Through Real-Time Neurofeedback

works.title: Splash into Bubbles
works.description: A sleep-onset installation that withdraws stimulation step by step: visuals first anchor attention on the breath and then fade, sound stays and then gives way to touch, until only a slow whole-body pneumatic swell remains.
works.description_zh: 一件帮助入睡的装置，逐步撤回刺激：先用画面把注意力锚定在呼吸上，随后画面淡出；声音留下，再让位给触觉，最后只剩下缓慢的全身气动起伏。
works.idea_en: To help someone fall asleep, the interface should recede with the body, letting the person's own rhythms become the strongest signal.
works.idea_zh: 要帮助人入睡，界面应当随身体一同退场，让人自身的节律成为最强的信号。
works.method: Respiration sensing drives staged visual, auditory, localised tactile and whole-body pneumatic feedback, each withdrawn as breathing steadies, following a model of sensory gating.
works.method_zh: 呼吸感测驱动分阶段的视觉、听觉、局部触觉与全身气动反馈，依据感觉门控模型，在呼吸趋于平稳时逐一撤回。

paper.title: Splash into Bubbles: Designing Somatic Immersion for Sleep Onset through Progressive Sensory Fading

works.title: Becoming My Own Audience
works.description: Fifteen dancers improvised live through motion-capture avatars of different genders, shapes and bodily limitations, watching themselves move on a digital stage in practice and performance.
works.description_zh: 十五位舞者借助性别、体型与身体限制各不相同的动作捕捉化身进行现场即兴，在练习与演出中看着自己在数字舞台上移动。
works.idea_en: Dancing as an unlike body lets dancers step outside habitual movement and try other ways of moving, including other genders.
works.idea_zh: 以一个不像自己的身体去跳舞，能让舞者走出习惯动作，尝试其他的动作方式，包括另一种性别。
works.method: Optical motion capture mapped dancers onto five avatars during practice and performance sessions, followed by interviews and movement analysis.
works.method_zh: 在练习与演出中以光学动作捕捉把舞者映射到五个化身上，随后进行访谈与动作分析。

paper.title: "Becoming My Own Audience": How Dancers React to Avatars Unlike Themselves in Motion Capture-Supported Live Improvisational Performance

works.title: Immersive Mixed Reality Street Play
works.description: Players in see-through mixed reality headsets train, duel and fight a dragon in streets and public venues while bystanders with phones join in other roles; in-the-wild studies of the MOFA games show how bodily play unfolds in public.
works.description_zh: 玩家戴着透视式混合现实头显，在街头与公共场所练习法术、对决、迎战巨龙，手持手机的旁观者也以其他角色加入；对 MOFA 游戏的实地研究展示了身体游戏如何在公共空间中展开。
works.idea_en: When headsets let play leave the screen, the street becomes a stage where players' bodies, gestures and onlookers together make the game.
works.idea_zh: 当头显让游戏离开屏幕，街道就成了舞台，玩家的身体、手势与围观者一同构成游戏。
works.method: The research-through-design game probe MOFA (The Training, The Duel, The Dragon) runs on see-through headsets with co-located networking, deployed at diverse public venues and studied through observation and interviews.
works.method_zh: 以设计为研究的游戏探针 MOFA（训练、对决、巨龙三种模式）运行在透视式头显上并支持同场联网，部署于多种公共场所，通过观察与访谈进行研究。

paper.title: Towards Immersive Mixed Reality Street Play: Understanding Co-located Bodily Play with See-through Head-Mounted Displays in Public Spaces

exhibited: MOFA: SIGGRAPH 2024 Immersive Pavilion Best in Show

works.title: Imaginary Joint
works.description: A wearable stretches the skin where a virtual tail meets the body, telling the wearer how far the tail is bent and how hard it pushes, so it can be felt without looking.
works.description_zh: 一款可穿戴装置在虚拟尾巴与身体相接处拉伸皮肤，告诉佩戴者尾巴弯了多少、用了多大的力，不看也能感觉到它。
works.idea_en: An extra body part feels like one's own when it has a felt joint: proprioception, not vision, makes a tail part of the body.
works.idea_zh: 多出来的身体部位要有一个可感的关节才会像自己的：让尾巴成为身体一部分的是本体感，而不是视觉。
works.method: Skin-stretch actuators at the junction between the real body and a virtual extension encode the bending angle and torque of an 'imaginary joint', compared with vibrotactile feedback in a controlled study.
works.method_zh: 在真实身体与虚拟延伸的接合处用皮肤拉伸执行器编码“想象关节”的弯曲角度与扭矩，并在对照实验中与振动反馈比较。

paper.title: Imaginary Joint: Proprioceptive Feedback for Virtual Body Extensions via Skin Stretch

exhibited: SIGGRAPH 2025 Emerging Technologies (Imaginary Joints and Muscles)

works.title: DobbyEar
works.description: In VR, people touch their own ears while their hand is subtly redirected, so the ear feels as if it had the shape of an elf's or a dog's ear.
works.description_zh: 在虚拟现实中，人们触摸自己的耳朵，而手的轨迹被悄悄重定向，于是耳朵摸起来像精灵耳或狗耳的形状。
works.idea_en: Self-touch can reshape the felt body: guiding the hand along a new contour makes one's own ear feel different.
works.idea_zh: 自我触摸可以重塑被感到的身体：引导手沿着新的轮廓移动，自己的耳朵就有了不同的感觉。
works.method: Haptic retargeting offsets the virtual hand from the real one as it traces the ear's contour, matched to elf- or dog-ear avatars; studies found the tolerable deviation angle and measured body ownership.
works.method_zh: 手沿耳廓移动时，触觉重定向让虚拟手偏离真实的手，并与精灵耳或狗耳化身相匹配；研究测出可容忍的偏差角度并测量身体拥有感。

paper.title: DobbyEar: Inducing Body Illusion of Ear Deformation with Haptic Retargeting

works.title: Light Up Fireflies
works.description: Two players share one VR avatar, each controlling one half of its body; they must move as one to walk, catch fireflies and keep the avatar from falling.
works.description_zh: 两名玩家共用一个虚拟现实化身，各自控制它的一半身体；两人必须动作一致，才能行走、捉萤火虫并让化身不摔倒。
works.idea_en: Sharing one body makes the other person's movement felt from inside, moving players from bodily strangeness to a shared bodily understanding.
works.idea_zh: 共用一个身体，让对方的动作从内部被感到，玩家由身体的陌生感走向对彼此身体的理解。
works.method: Two-player VR game that maps each player's tracked movements to one half of a shared avatar, studied with 16 participants.
works.method_zh: 双人虚拟现实游戏，把每位玩家被追踪的动作映射到共享化身的一半身体上，共 16 名参与者参与研究。

paper.title: Light Up Fireflies: Exploring the Design of Interpersonal Bodily Intertwinement in Social Body Games

works.title: Life-Size Dance: Improvisation, Somaesthetics, and the Practice of Toru Iwashita
works.description: An essay on Toru Iwashita, a Sankai Juku butoh dancer from the 1980s to 2024, whose 'life-size' improvisation is built from lying down, rolling and standing up, and who leads dance therapy workshops, including long-term work on a psychiatric ward.
works.description_zh: 一篇关于岩下徹的文章：岩下徹自 1980 年代至 2024 年是山海塾的舞踏舞者，其“等身大”的即兴由躺下、翻滚、站起等日常动作构成，并长期带领舞蹈治疗工作坊，包括在精神科病房的工作。
works.idea_en: Dance grounded in everyday movement can be a way back into the body after a mental-health crisis: improvisation as empathetic communication with oneself, others and the world.
works.idea_zh: 扎根于日常动作的舞蹈，可以是心理危机之后重新回到身体的道路：即兴是与自己、他人和世界的共情交流。
works.method: Interview-based study of Iwashita's practice read through somaesthetics, in a Journal of Somaesthetics issue of interviews with artists and somatic practitioners.
works.method_zh: 以访谈为基础，从身体美学角度解读岩下徹的实践，收录于《身体美学期刊》艺术家与身体修习者访谈专刊。

paper.title: Life-Size Dance: Improvisation, Somaesthetics, and the Practice of Toru Iwashita

works.title: Body Rhythm and Martial Roots: A Somaesthetic Return in Chinese Classical Dance
works.description: An interview study with Xin Li, professor of Chinese classical dance at the Beijing Dance Academy, and Wenlong Li, a practitioner in the taiji and bajiquan lineages, on how shenyun (body rhythm) and martial training cultivate the body.
works.description_zh: 一项访谈研究，对象是北京舞蹈学院中国古典舞教授 Xin Li 与太极、八极拳一脉的习武者 Wenlong Li，探讨身韵与武术训练如何修炼身体。
works.idea_en: Chinese classical dance and martial arts share a training of inner awareness that shows outwardly as rhythm and presence: somaesthetic cultivation rather than technique alone.
works.idea_zh: 中国古典舞与武术共享一种内在觉察的训练，并外显为韵律与气场：这是身体美学意义上的修身，而不只是技术。
works.method: Comparative interviews with a dance professor and a martial artist, analysed through somaesthetics.
works.method_zh: 对一位舞蹈教授与一位武术家进行比较访谈，并以身体美学加以分析。

paper.title: Body Rhythm and Martial Roots: A Somaesthetic Return in Chinese Classical Dance

works.title: Super Mom Training Gym
works.description: A game and installation built from a 3D scan of the artist's nine-month pregnant body: the heavy, restricted body becomes a superhero that jumps twenty metres, lifts hospitals, kicks insurance forms and clones itself to multitask.
works.description_zh: 一件游戏与装置作品，取材于艺术家怀孕九个月时的身体三维扫描：沉重、受限的身体变成能跳二十米、举起医院、踢飞保险表格、分身多任务的超级英雄。
works.idea_en: Animating the pregnant body as superhuman gives relief through fantasy and, at the same time, exposes the impossible demands placed on mothers.
works.idea_zh: 把怀孕的身体做成超人，既在幻想中带来释放，也揭示了社会对母亲不可能完成的要求。
works.method: A 3D body scan rigged in a character animator and turned into a playable game shown as an installation, made with Lauren Schroeder.
works.method_zh: 将身体三维扫描导入角色动画软件并绑定骨骼，做成可游玩的游戏，以装置形式展出，与 Lauren Schroeder 合作完成。

works.title: Shape-Kit
works.description: A hybrid toolkit for crafting touch: a designer presses, strokes and shapes with the hand, the touch is transduced into moving pin-based sensations that can be placed anywhere on the body, and a tracking module records the patterns.
works.description_zh: 一套“手作触觉”的混合工具包：设计者用手按压、抚摸、塑形，这些触摸被转换为可放在身体任何部位的动态针阵感觉，追踪模块同时记录下这些图案。
works.idea_en: Touch can be designed the way it is given, by hand and on the body, before it is turned into code.
works.idea_zh: 触觉可以像给予触摸那样去设计：先用手、在身体上，然后才变成代码。
works.method: Hand-driven pin arrays transmit touch to other body sites while an ad-hoc tracking module digitises the patterns; a study with 14 designers and artists analysed how they ideated, prototyped and composed touch together.
works.method_zh: 由手驱动的针阵把触摸传到身体其他部位，临时搭建的追踪模块把图案数字化；14 位设计师与艺术家参与研究，分析他们如何共同构思、制作原型并编排触觉。

paper.title: Shape-Kit: A Design Toolkit for Crafting On-Body Expressive Haptics

works.title: The Third Between Us
works.description: Several visitors wearing headphones move freely on a vibrating floor; a shared 'vibroscape' of spatial sound and haptics lets them sense each other's presence and interact without seeing one another.
works.description_zh: 数位戴着耳机的参观者在振动地板上自由移动；由空间声音与触觉组成的共享“振动景观”让他们不用看见彼此，也能感到对方的存在并互动。
works.idea_en: Togetherness does not need sight: a third, shared field of vibration and sound can hold several bodies in one felt space.
works.idea_zh: “在一起”不一定需要视觉：一片共享的振动与声音的“第三场域”，可以把几个身体容纳在同一个可感的空间里。
works.method: Position sensing, headphones with real-time spatial audio and floor haptic actuators form the 'Shared Vibroscape' system, studied through observation at an exhibition.
works.method_zh: 位置感测、实时空间音频耳机与地板触觉执行器组成“共享振动景观”系统，并在展览中通过观察进行研究。

paper.title: The Third Between Us: Exploring Multi-User Co-Presence through Shared Auditory-Haptic Vibroscapes

works.title: Induced Human-Driven Actuation
works.description: Instead of moving the body for the user, the machine only decides when a movement the person is already making is released; in a throwing study, people reached distinct target distances, which tactile timing cues did not achieve.
works.description_zh: 机器不替使用者移动身体，只决定人正在做出的动作何时被释放；在投掷研究中，参与者能投出区分明确的目标距离，而触觉提示做不到。
works.idea_en: Augmentation can keep the movement human: the body generates the action and the machine only gates its timing, trading control stability against the felt experience of authorship.
works.idea_zh: 增强可以让动作仍属于人：身体产生动作，机器只把关时机，而这需要在控制的稳定性与“动作是我做的”这一亲身感受之间取舍。
works.method: A case-study throwing system uses electrical muscle stimulation within a constraint-release mechanism: the person generates the throw and the machine gates its timing; a user study compared it with tactile cues and varied the degree of machine intervention.
works.method_zh: 以投掷系统为案例，在约束释放机制中使用肌肉电刺激：投掷动作由人产生，机器把关时机；用户研究将其与触觉提示比较，并改变机器介入的程度。

paper.title: Induced Human-Driven Actuation: Controlling Timing of Human Movement via Constraint-Release Mechanism

works.title: Somatic Drawing Tool: 3D Body Sheet
works.description: A VR drawing tool, co-designed with synaesthetes, in which people draw on and around an immersive 3D body sheet to show where and how one sense triggers another.
works.description_zh: 一款与联觉者共同设计的虚拟现实绘画工具，人们在沉浸式三维身体图纸上及其周围作画，表现一种感官在何处、以何种方式引发另一种感官。
works.idea_en: When there are no shared words for a sensation, drawing it in three dimensions around a body lets highly individual experience be articulated and compared.
works.idea_zh: 当一种感觉没有共通的词语时，在身体周围以三维方式把它画出来，能让极其个人化的体验得以表达与比较。
works.method: Participatory workshops with a community of synaesthetes tested text, creative tools and sensory materials, then informed an iteratively developed VR drawing system built on soma design body sheets.
works.method_zh: 与联觉者社群开展参与式工作坊，试验文字、创作工具与感官材料，据此迭代开发以身体设计中的身体图纸为基础的虚拟现实绘画系统。

paper.title: Somatic Drawing Tool: 3D Body Sheet as Material for Articulating Synaesthetic Experiences

works.title: Holding MenstaRay
works.description: MenstaRay is a knitted soft robot, held in the hands, that swells and contracts to mimic the timing and fluctuations of menstrual pain; holding it helps menstruators recall, reflect on and talk about their own pain.
works.description_zh: MenstaRay 是一个捧在手中的针织软体机器人，它的膨胀与收缩模仿经痛的时间节律与起伏；握着它，经期中的人更容易回想、反思并讲述自己的疼痛。
works.idea_en: Pain that tracking apps turn into numbers can be given back its organic, messy rhythm in a soft moving material, inviting self-care and acceptance.
works.idea_zh: 被追踪应用变成数字的疼痛，可以在柔软而会动的材料中重获其有机、杂乱的节律，并引向自我照护与接纳。
works.method: Material workshops with menstruators led to a programmable knitted soft-robotic artefact; sensory interaction sessions and interviews were analysed through a feminist lens.
works.method_zh: 与经期人群开展材料工作坊，制作出可编程的针织软体机器人物件；通过感官互动环节与访谈，从女性主义视角进行分析。

paper.title: Holding MenstaRay: Expressing Menstrual Pain through Tactile and Knitted Soft Robotic Interactions

works.title: Soma Design for Digital Mental Health and Well-Being Interventions: Scoping Review
works.description: A PRISMA scoping review of how soma design has been used to build digital mental health and well-being interventions: nine papers, ranging from design concepts by adolescents to researcher-made prototypes, all built around soma awareness exercises, most often Feldenkrais lessons.
works.description_zh: 一篇按 PRISMA 规范进行的范围综述，梳理身体设计如何被用于开发数字心理健康与身心安适干预：共纳入九篇论文，从青少年提出的设计概念到研究者制作的原型，全都以身体觉察练习为核心，其中最常用的是费登奎斯课程。
works.idea_en: Soma design reaches mental health through the body: every intervention found starts from somatic awareness exercises rather than from screens.
works.idea_zh: 身体设计通过身体抵达心理健康：综述中的每一项干预都从身体觉察练习出发，而不是从屏幕出发。
works.method: Scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, including studies that used soma design to develop digital mental health and well-being interventions.
works.method_zh: 按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南进行范围综述，纳入以身体设计开发数字心理健康与身心安适干预的研究。

paper.title: Soma Design for Digital Mental Health and Well-Being Interventions: Scoping Review

works.title: Scaffolding Somatic Design (ART framework)
works.description: A teaching framework of Action, Reflection and Transformation (ART): design students explore their own bodily experience, reflect on it together through shared enactment and critique, and translate movement insights into expressive form.
works.description_zh: 一个由“行动、反思、转化”（ART）构成的教学框架：设计专业学生探索自己的身体体验，通过共同演示与批评一起反思，再把来自动作的洞见转化为有表现力的形式。
works.idea_en: Somatic sensitivity can be scaffolded in design education: first-person movement, reflection with others and transformation into form make the soma both method and material.
works.idea_zh: 身体感受力可以在设计教育中被“搭建”起来：第一人称的动作、与他人的共同反思和向形式的转化，让身体既是方法也是材料。
works.method: Multi-session workshop with undergraduate design students structured by the ART principles, with bodily exploration, shared enactment and performative critique.
works.method_zh: 以 ART 原则组织、面向本科设计学生的多次工作坊，包含身体探索、共同演示与表演式批评。

paper.title: Scaffolding Somatic Design: Action, Reflection, and Transformation in an Educational Workshop

works.title: It's Like Being On Stage
works.description: A contemporary dance piece co-created with five professional dancers in which 128 audience members wore haptic wristbands that carried the dancers' movement qualities as vibration during three live performances.
works.description_zh: 一部与五位职业舞者共同创作的当代舞作品：在三场现场演出中，128 名观众佩戴触觉腕带，舞者的动作质感以振动的形式传到他们身上。
works.idea_en: Touch lets an audience feel a dancer's expressiveness in their own body, turning spectatorship into a felt resonance with the stage.
works.idea_zh: 触觉让观众在自己的身体里感受到舞者的表现力，把观看变成与舞台之间可感的共振。
works.method: Co-design sessions with dancers combined choreography with custom haptic wristband patterns; open-ended questionnaires and interviews with audience members after the performances.
works.method_zh: 与舞者共同设计，把编舞与定制的触觉腕带振动图案结合；演出后对观众进行开放式问卷与访谈。

paper.title: "It's Like Being On Stage": Conveying Dancers' Expressiveness Through A Haptic-Installed Contemporary Dance Performance

works.title: Flytrap Hand
works.description: Inspired by the Venus flytrap, a distance sensor triggers electrical muscle stimulation that snaps the wearer's hand shut on approaching objects, a grasping 'superpower' that also brings discomfort and uncertainty about who is moving.
works.description_zh: 受捕蝇草启发，距离传感器触发肌肉电刺激，让佩戴者的手在物体靠近时猛然合拢；这种抓取“超能力”同时带来不适，以及“到底是谁在动”的不确定。
works.idea_en: Superpowers that act through the body have a cost felt in the body: augmentation design should weigh the unfortunate effects of automation from the start.
works.idea_zh: 借助身体实现的超能力，其代价也由身体承受：增强设计应当从一开始就权衡自动化带来的负面效应。
works.method: Distance sensing drives EMS of the hand muscles for accelerated grasping; a mixed-method study (N=12) informed a design framework for 'fortunate' and 'unfortunate' superpowers.
works.method_zh: 距离感测驱动手部肌肉电刺激以加速抓握；一项 12 人的混合方法研究据此提出关于“幸运”与“不幸”超能力的设计框架。

paper.title: Towards Understanding The Design of (Un)Fortunate Superpowers Through A Flytrap-Inspired Hand Augmentation
